none: PAS NLM-DD5A73: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Hibaldstow
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]ONSTA[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [--]ORI AEXER[--]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this tiny coin. Diameter: 12.6mm, Weight: 1.26gms, die axis: 12
